source: FHFA Conforming Loan Limit Values (annual announcement, published November); HUD FHA Single-Family Mortgage Limits (annual, published December). The 2027 conforming baseline is the FHFA-announced one-unit limit applied in the 48 contiguous states (Alaska, Hawaii, Guam, and the US Virgin Islands receive the HERA high-cost ceiling as their CONFORMING baseline; FHA limits there are set county by county). The FHA floor is 65 percent of the conforming baseline; the FHA ceiling is 150 percent. VA loan limits were removed for full-entitlement borrowers by the Blue Water Navy Vietnam Veterans Act effective 2020. CONFORMING figures (baseline and every bundled county) were read on 2026-11-25 from the FHFA 2027 full county list, fullcountyloanlimitlist2027_hera-based_final_flat.csv, whose modal tuple across 3,235 counties is the baseline and whose per-county one-unit value is the row below; the one-unit baseline $855,400 and the $1,283,100 ceiling also match the FHFA release of 2026-11-24. FHA figures are HUD's CY2026 values, checked county by county against the HUD CY2026 lookup on 2026-09-24 and still in force: they differ from the conforming limit county by county (Honolulu FHA $828,000, Anchorage FHA $541,287, Maui $1,299,500). The bundled county rows are a sample of high-cost counties (CA, NY, DC, MA, CO, HI, AK) and are NOT limited to counties at the national ceiling -- Napa, the five New York City boroughs, Pitkin and Maui each carry their own published value. Any county not bundled routes to the FHFA / HUD lookup.
edition: Conforming: FHFA Conforming Loan Limit Values for 2027 (announced 2026-11-24, effective 2027-01-01). FHA: HUD FHA Single-Family Mortgage Limits for CY2026 (ML 2025-23) -- HUD had not published CY2027 limits as of 2026-11-25 (the hud.gov limit lookup offered CY2024 / CY2025 / CY2026 only), so the FHA column is the CY2026 value still in force. VA loan-limit policy per Public Law 116-23.
free_access: FHFA: fhfa.gov/data/conforming-loan-limit. HUD FHA: entp.hud.gov/idapp/html/hicostlook.cfm. VA: benefits.va.gov.
unknown_county_message: Unknown county. The 2027 conforming baseline applies in the 48 contiguous states (one-unit $855,400); the FHA floor is HUD's CY2026 $541,287 until HUD publishes CY2027 limits. Alaska / Hawaii / Guam / USVI receive the high-cost ceiling $1,283,100 as their conforming baseline. Only a sample of high-cost counties is bundled, so a county between the baseline and the ceiling may carry its own published value. Look yours up at fhfa.gov / entp.hud.gov, or ask your lender.
